hero.name: Kiflan Anugerah Syawal
hero.bio: I am a highly motivated technology enthusiast with strong critical thinking and teamwork abilities. As an experienced robotics programmer and IT specialist, I excel under pressure and possess skills in C, C++, OpenCR microcontrollers, web development frameworks, as well as Cisco and MikroTik network configuration. I have achieved notable success, securing 3rd place nationally in humanoid robot soccer (2023), 2nd place (2024), and funding for a student creativity program. With effective English communication skills (IELTS 6, CEFR B2), I am eager to apply my knowledge and collaborate in a technology career.
